eligibility.quote: In short, the generated code for the message is wrongly considered plain.

failed_conditions.quote: The root cause is mismatch between CDR representation and in-memory representation due to different alignment of fields.

resolution.quote: @MiguelCompany This seems to fix the problem for me using `rmw_fastrtps_cpp`, thanks for that.

notes: 独立核验：(1) issue #715 正文逐字确认（Outer.msg/Inner.msg 定义、发布 true/接收 false 的输出、"Received message have wrong values for boolean fields."、版本清单 ros-iron-rmw-fastrtps-cpp 7.1.1-2jammy.20230908.165835 与 ros-iron-rosidl-typesupport-fastrtps-cpp 3.0.1-1jammy.20230908.162358、CycloneDDS 不受影响）。(2) clalancette "I'm also able to observe this behavior, when the publisher and subscriber are in the same process." 与 MiguelCompany "This is reproduced when the sample is accessed via `rmw_take_loaned_message`." 均确认。(3) PR #108 "Account for alignment on `is_plain` calculations" 合并于 2023-10-04；其 diff 确认修复逻辑 "is_plain = (offsetof(DataType, @(last_member_name_)) + last_member_size) == ret_val;"；引文 "The root cause is mismatch between CDR representation and in-memory representation due to different alignment of fields." 与 "So what we are doing with this (and related) PR is disallowing the loans (marking the type as not plain) on those types where there is a representation mismatch." 均出自 MiguelCompany 在 PR #108 的评论，逐字确认。(4) 代码三点确认：3.0.1 模板第 500 行 "is_plain ? ROSIDL_TYPESUPPORT_FASTRTPS_PLAIN_TYPE :"；7.1.1 type_support_common.cpp 第 41 行 "is_plain_ = bounds_info == ROSIDL_TYPESUPPORT_FASTRTPS_PLAIN_TYPE;"；rmw_take.cpp 第 565 行 "subscription->can_loan_messages = info->type_support_->is_plain();"。(5) iron 回移 PR #109 经 mergify 确认；fujitatomoya 在回移完成后关单。representation_convention 分类成立（跨界的是 plain 标志与借样字节布局的表示约定）；clalancette 的验证未标明两单元修订，recommended 成立。报告者 workaround（"putting the boolean field in front of the float field in Inner.msg"）与 rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp 失败（另一组合，PR #716）已在规格 notes 记录，非遗漏条件。
